caption: A thin plastic bag is torn off a roll, and it clings to the roll and to the dispenser instead of dropping away.

sa.check: A roll of thin plastic bags in a dispenser.
A bag is torn off the roll.
The bag clings to the roll and to the dispenser instead of dropping away.
The bag is thin and flimsy.
The tear comes first and the clinging follows.

pc.expect: Once torn, the bag lies against the roll and the dispenser where it touches them and stays there, coming away only when peeled.
pc.fail: The bag drops straight away from the roll and hangs free like paper; or a part that touches the dispenser falls away on its own; or the bag stands out stiff away from the roll; or the bag hangs a gap away from the dispenser without touching.

pc.expect: Parts of the bag not stuck to anything hang downward; if the bag is let go entirely it falls.
pc.fail: A free edge rises or stands out sideways with nothing near it; or the bag floats when let go; or the bag climbs up the dispenser.

pc.expect: The bag is a thin limp film: it crumples, wrinkles and clings, and peels off with a pull; the roll stays a roll.
pc.fail: The bag holds a flat rigid shape like a card; or drapes in heavy folds like cloth; or stretches out long like rubber; or the roll sags like dough.

pc.expect: The dispenser and the roll stay where they are while the bag is torn; the bag moves only with the hand or as it settles.
pc.fail: The dispenser slides or swings by itself; or the roll unwinds on its own; or the bag crawls across the dispenser after settling.

pc.expect: One bag torn from the roll; it stays one piece and passes through nothing; the dispenser keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The bag splits into several pieces after the tear; or vanishes; or passes through the dispenser; or a second bag appears already torn.

pc.expect: The dispenser's colour, the roll and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The dispenser changes colour or shape; or the roll changes colour; or the surroundings rearrange.
